properties.notes: The site is the remainder of a larger scheme for tied staff accommodation at Cheam Hawtreys School (BDB/63103, approved 2006). The school has confirmed, through the site monitoring consultation, that whilst the site will be delivered in due course, at present they have no intention to build out the remaining 6 units within the next 5 years. The site has therefore been phased into the 5-10 year time band and its future delivery will continue to be reviewed through the annual monitoring process.. Erection of 12 terraced and semi-detached dwellings
